Population increased in Pendle

The estimated population of Pendle in 2024 was 99,777 usual residents, a rise of 1.9% since 2023.

This meant that Pendle's rate of population change placed it among the 20 percent fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Pendle increased by 4.1%.

Over this slightly longer period, Pendle was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Pendle

The average (median) age fell to 39.2 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Pendle has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Pendle is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Pendle's population of 99,777 usual residents was made up of:

  • 21,214 people aged 0 to 15 years, (21.3%)
  • 60,254 people aged 16 to 64 years, (60.4%)
  • 18,309 people aged 65 years and over, (18.3%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Pendle has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 0 to 15 years (21.3% compared with 18.3% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Pendle, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Pendle
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Pendle, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 167 people (0.2%). In total, there were 1,146 births and 979 deaths in Pendle.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 638 (0.7%). There were 5,148 people entering the area and 4,510 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Pendle's population of 1,102 (1.1%) as a result of 1,638 people entering the area and 536 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Pendle was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Pendle in mid-2023 is 97,881.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 526 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 316 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 842 people.
